newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market slow, steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market slow, steady - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady on a dressed basis delivered, paid on hot carcass weights, according to USDA.
Dressed basis steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1300 lbs 110.00. Dressed Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 110.00.
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers slow on Friday morning. Prices not established on either class on a live basis. Buyer inquiry fair, seller interest limited.
Slaughter Heifers: No confirmed sales. Sales confirmed: 600. For the week: None.
